_twist: Typographic hover: letter-spacing expansion on buttons, scaleX underline reveal on links — no color changes, no box-shadow — intensity 2

button._note: Subtle tracking expansion — the type loosens as you approach, no color shift

link._note: No color change on link hover — underline is the only indicator

focus._note: Minimum accessible focus — matches hairline weight of structural dividers

active._note: Active state via opacity only — no scale, no color shift

visited._note: Visited links retain near-black — no secondary text color tier

rules._note: Typographic mass is stable under interaction — weight register does not shift, scale, or animate in response to cursor events
